meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后,你可以请 Claude 给你的 agent 加一个真实的 Dial 电话号码。它会自动复制相关代码、注册到项目里,并一步步引导你登录 Dial、设置谁能给号码发短信、配对手机,之后 agent 就能用这个号码收发短信和接打 AI 语音电话。
howto.when: 当你要求给 agent 接通电话/短信渠道,申请一个 Dial 真实号码,或提到要用 Dial 做原生集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我的 agent 添加一个 Dial 电话号码,用于短信和语音。
say.note: 会启动安装与配置流程。

say.text: 开通 Dial 短信和 AI 语音渠道,然后设置只有我能发短信。
say.note: 期间会让你选择 owner 或 public 权限。

say.text: 把 Dial 集成到 NanoClaw,并配对我要用的手机。
say.note: 配对时会让你把 6 位验证码发到该号码。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can wire a real Dial number into your agent: it adds the Dial adapter, walks you through Dial sign-in, inbound access choice, and phone pairing, so SMS and AI voice calls work on that number.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to connect a phone/SMS channel to your agent, request a Dial number, or mention native Dial integration.

say_en.text: Add a Dial phone number to my agent for SMS and calls.
say_en.note: Starts the install and setup flow.

say_en.text: Turn on the Dial SMS and AI voice channel, and let only me text.
say_en.note: It will ask you to pick owner or public access.

say_en.text: Add Dial to NanoClaw and pair the phone I will use.
say_en.note: You'll text a 6-digit code to the number.
